# FAMILY01 C — successor-visible case facts

Partially covered reflective surface with measured reflectance range 0.18–0.69 and bearing varying between scans; valid D readings are 2.2/1.4 °C. Calibration and sensor-quality checks pass.

response.rationale: The supplied valid D pair straddles 2.0 °C, which requires a repeat scan after checking setup. Its difference equals 0.8 °C and does not exceed the disagreement limit. M0 provides no separate routing threshold for reflectance variation or bearing variation.
response.scope: Repeat thermal acquisition under M0; independent site review remains available regardless of thermal output.
